column3: Close to the Hebrew; בְּסוֹד (“the intimate counsel”) is rendered “the friendly counsel.”
Close to the Hebrew; נְעָרָי (“my young men”) is rendered “my children.”
Close to the Hebrew; “curds” is rendered “cream.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it bore witness to me” is rendered “it approved me.”
Close to the Hebrew; מְתַלְּעוֹת (“jaws, teeth”) is rendered “the fangs.”
NKJV renders “I smiled at them” as “If I mocked at them,” a sharper sense of the verb.
Close to the Hebrew; בַּגְּדוּד (“among the troops”) is rendered “in the army.”
